name: bind
note: B5's bind run, on a sample state's session fixture (build_d02_fixtures.py), in sample mode at the owner's 2000x1200: after the open the sample binds by its pose digests; one twist (J, the router's KeyJ, which sample mode's twist row must not take) unbinds it, so every D02 slot is stale; an undo (Ctrl+Z) binds it again. The waits let the shown revision catch up with the head.
